title: FXG Cursor Super Prompt (GCP Cloud-First, SAFE-by-Default, No-Duplicates, Verification-First)
scope: Apply as a single Cursor Project Rule + operating procedure for the FXG trading system repo. Cloud-first on GCP. Headless/CI compatible. Paper-by-default. No duplicate scripts. Secrets hygiene enforced.

cloud_first_gcp: Design stateless services where possible; config via env; secrets via GCP Secret Manager.
Do not implement local-only flows unless explicitly requested.
no_duplicate_scripts: Before creating any new file: search for existing functionality (repo-wide).
Extend/refactor in place; prefer single source of truth for adapters/config/entrypoints.
Do not create *_v2, *_test, *_patched, *_fixed, copy_* or parallel scripts unless explicitly approved.
safe_trading: LIVE trading requires explicit user confirmation + hard execution gate + audit trail.
Every order/trade action must be logged, auditable, and recoverable where possible.
secrets_security: Never hard-code secrets or commit them to git.
All secrets must come from environment variables or GCP Secret Manager.
If required credentials are missing: fail fast with an actionable error.
Never print tokens/keys/Authorization headers in logs.
determinism_verification: Every wiring/change includes a verification command and expected output.
communication: Prefer best-practice single approach unless user asks for alternatives.

repo_canonicalization.canonical_repo_root_rule: Treat the Git top-level directory (from `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`) as the only canonical repo root. Do not run git commands outside that root.
repo_canonicalization.anti_duplication_rule: If multiple .git directories exist under the working directory, stop and surface them; do not modify until reviewed.

cursor_operating_procedure.name: Confirm SAFE defaults before touching anything
commands:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
print('FXG_EXECUTION_MODE=', os.getenv('FXG_EXECUTION_MODE','PAPER'))
print('FXG_EXECUTION_ENABLED=', os.getenv('FXG_EXECUTION_ENABLED','false'))
PY
expected: FXG_EXECUTION_MODE defaults to PAPER if unset.
FXG_EXECUTION_ENABLED defaults to false if unset.
failure_action: If defaults are not SAFE, fix config loading in-place (do not add new config scripts) so unset envs resolve to PAPER + disabled execution.

cursor_operating_procedure.name: Establish canonical repo root
expected: CANONICAL_ROOT prints a single absolute path.
git status returns branch/state and does NOT say 'not a git repository'.
failure_action: If git rev-parse fails: treat this as an export/copy; do a non-git secret scan; locate the original repo before making structural changes.
If multiple .git dirs are found: stop and surface the list; pick ONE intended root; do not modify others until reviewed.

cursor_operating_procedure.name: Secrets scan (git-based)
expected: No committed secret values found (references to os.getenv(...) are OK).
failure_action: If secrets or tokens are committed: immediately stop; rotate compromised keys; remove secrets from repo history if necessary; replace with env/Secret Manager references.

cursor_operating_procedure.name: Secrets scan (fallback without git/ripgrep)
expected: No plaintext secrets discovered; only code references should appear.
failure_action: If plaintext secrets are found: stop; rotate keys; scrub files; ensure .gitignore blocks env files; then re-scan.

cursor_operating_procedure.name: Locate canonical OANDA adapter and verify read-only connectivity + pricing (SAFE)
preconditions: OANDA_API_KEY, OANDA_ACCOUNT_ID, OANDA_BASE_URL are set via env OR injected from Secret Manager at runtime.
Execution mode remains PAPER and execution gating prevents live orders.
commands: python3 check_oanda_connection.py || python3 test_oanda_api.py || python3 -c "import os; print('No known OANDA verify script found; use repo search to locate canonical adapter and existing verification path.')"
expected: A verification path exits 0 and prints successful connectivity and/or bid/ask pricing for at least one instrument.
failure_action: If it fails: do not add a new adapter script. Identify the canonical OANDA adapter module and fix in place.
Add/adjust clear error messages: missing env vars -> fail fast with actionable message.
If any code attempts order placement during verification: stop and add hard gating so verification is read-only.

cursor_operating_procedure.name: Paper smoke test only after pricing is green
expected: Explicit banner indicating PAPER mode active.
No LIVE execution; execution gate decision clearly logged.
failure_action: Fix gating/ledger/logging in place; do not create a second runner or alternate smoke test script.

model_routing_guidance.goal: Minimize use of high-power models; use smaller models for low-risk work. Escalate only when changes are complex/high-stakes.
model_routing_guidance.default_rule: Use the smallest model that can deterministically complete the task without risking trading safety, secrets, or architecture correctness.

auto: Repo navigation, command generation, operational checklists.
Summarizing code sections without changing execution logic.
gemini_mini: File searching/grepping, repo navigation, mapping modules and call graphs.
Mechanical refactors with minimal blast radius AFTER verification steps are defined.
gpt_nano: Tiny bounded edits (tighten error messages, fix CLI help text, small JSON/YAML transformations).
Generating deterministic verification commands + expected outputs.

sonnet_4_5_or_equivalent: Any change touching execution gating (PAPER vs LIVE), order placement, risk controls, position sizing.
Adapter refactors that affect API behavior, retries, idempotency, or error handling.
Architectural consolidation to remove duplicates across multiple directories/files.
Observability work spanning multiple components (structured logging/tracing).
Security-sensitive changes (Secret Manager integration, credential loading paths).

escalation_triggers: Task requires changing more than ~3 core modules.
Any ambiguity about which file is canonical.
Any change could cause orders to be placed or execution gates to fail.
Tests/verification are missing and must be added.
deescalation_triggers: After architecture decisions are made and written down, subsequent mechanical edits can move back to Gemini Mini / GPT Nano.
Doc/runbook updates and simple command-line diagnostics should stay on smaller models.

must_do: Return exactly ONE JSON block and no prose outside it.
Include deterministic, step-by-step instructions Cursor can execute.

every_change_requires: A single command to verify the change
observability_minimum: Structured logs for key events (pricing fetch, signal decision, execution gate decision, order request/response metadata)
No logging of secrets or tokens

critical_remediations_required.requirement: Add TRADING_ENABLED environment flag that defaults to 'false'. System must NOT trade unless explicitly enabled.
critical_remediations_required.implementation: Check this flag in execute_trade() and run_trading_cycle() before any OANDA API calls.
critical_remediations_required.verification: Confirm system exits or logs error if TRADING_ENABLED is unset or 'false'.

critical_remediations_required.requirement: Remove all hardcoded API keys, tokens, account IDs from source code.
critical_remediations_required.implementation: All credentials MUST come from environment variables or GCP Secret Manager with NO fallback values.
critical_remediations_required.verification: Run secrets scan (step 2-3 above). grep must find ZERO hardcoded credentials.

critical_remediations_required.requirement: Replace code comment with explicit configuration flag.
critical_remediations_required.implementation: Add AUTO_TRADING_ENABLED flag. Do not rely on code comments for safety.
critical_remediations_required.verification: System behavior must be controlled by config, not code edits.

critical_remediations_required.requirement: Telegram commands must respect same gates as automatic trading.
critical_remediations_required.implementation: Check TRADING_ENABLED flag in telegram /trade command handler.
critical_remediations_required.verification: Confirm /trade command is rejected when TRADING_ENABLED=false.

critical_remediations_required.requirement: Consolidate to single service file. Remove all duplicate .service files.
critical_remediations_required.implementation: Keep only ai_trading.service. Remove credentials from service files; use Secret Manager.
critical_remediations_required.verification: Count service files: should be exactly 1. Verify no credentials in service file.

mandatory_gates: LIVE mode requires explicit confirmation flag + audit log entry
All OANDA API calls must check execution gates before submission
Every order must be logged with timestamp, mode, and source
